newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen SEG 96 net soars 61.71 pct.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen SEG 96 net soars 61.71 pct.

text.p: (in millions of yuan unless stated, against 1995 figures)
Earnings per share 0.578 yuan vs 0.431 yuan
Earnings per share 0.461 yuan vs 0.431 yuan
Net assets per share 2.598 yuan vs 1.538 yuan
Company name: Shenzhen SEG Co Ltd.
Note: The results, published in an annual report in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times on Friday, were calculated under Chinese accounting standards.

Based on international standards, the company posted a net profit of 127.22 million yuan for 1996. The firm booked net profits of 100.05 million yuan for 1995, according to the firm's B share listing statement published last July.

The company, a colour television tube maker that also produces pagers and home video equipment, proposed a three-for-10 bonus issue based on 1996 profits, pending approval of shareholders at a meeting on May 28, the report said.
